purpose: Development diagnostic only. Locate exact unique32-code-point prefix/suffix anchors after complete extraction, trace one bounded optimal edit script and preserve original strict scores. No text repair, relaxed normalization, best-of selection, replacement labels or accuracy claim.
normalization: Existing ASCII-whitespace collapse only, preserving NBSP, punctuation, physical hyphens, case and Unicode.
trace_policy: One global Levenshtein script on a uniquely anchored diagnostic span. Prefer diagonal then deletion then insertion. Record visited predecessor ties; these do not prove alignment uniqueness or extraction-error causes.
unlocated_policy: Retain missing, duplicate, short, reversed or budget-exceeded observations with original reference denominators. Never choose a best anchor occurrence.
